assertion.statement: The two actual extra Kummer classes on E_n and E_(n theta), after restricted RC and forward analytic-rank-one imply Sha[2]=0, produce exactly eleven rational witnesses for the original pole template with the same B and m.
assertion.objects: Points(x1,y1),(x2,y2), x_i=A q_i^2, H=theta c^2, e=n/q1^2,z=c q2/q1,r1=y1/q1^3,r2=c^3 y2/(q1^3 z),w=(eHz)^(-1), and the six already chosen bits of m.
assertion.hypotheses: Both n,n theta are positive squarefree congruent11 mod12, with full2-Selmer dimension3, full2-infinity Selmer corank1 and extra class(beta,1) outside all rational2-torsion images. Retain restricted RC, rational modularity and the forward rank-one theorem.
assertion.quantifiers: For the original fixed B,m,A,H and the simultaneous pair n,n theta, choose rational representatives of their actual Kummer classes only after proving Sha[2]=0.
assertion.parameter_range: All q_i,c,e,z are nonzero rational numbers; theta=1 is allowed.
assertion.uniformity: Works for every B in the PC domain supplied by the simultaneous construction; no extra independent multiplier choice.
assertion.constants: Exactly the original six bits and five rational witnesses; no new template variables.
assertion.normalizations: Second point is(Az^2,z r2) on E_(eH). Dividing its cubic equation by z^2 yields r2^2=A(Az^2-eH)(Az^2+3eH), retaining leading factor A.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Extra class excludes infinity and all root points, so ordinates/abscissas and all denominators are nonzero. If theta=1 reuse one point and take q2=q1. Finite Sha is concluded from forward rank only, never assumed for RC.
assertion.limit_order: Exact Selmer dimension then full corank, then two restricted RC applications, then forward rank and Sha[2]=0, then actual points and final rational scaling.
